mayhem_at_midnight.title: Mayhem at Midnight
mayhem_at_midnight.shortDescription: A chilling psychological thriller that explores the cost of obsession, the fragility of identity, and the terrifying moment when a storyteller becomes the story.
summary: He came seeking a story. What he found was a mirror.
At what moment does a storyteller intertwine with the very tale they weave?

When an ambitious writer, consumed by his desire for inspiration, finds himself face-to-face with a notorious serial killer to craft the definitive true crime book, how deep must he delve into the darkness before losing his identity and transforming into the monster he initially sought to comprehend?
What begins as research becomes ritual. What was once curiosity turns into compulsion.

built_from_her_bones.title: Built From Her Bones
built_from_her_bones.subtitle: A Mayhem at Midnight Novel
built_from_her_bones.coverAlt: Built From Her Bones book cover
built_from_her_bones.shortDescription: A gritty, heart-pounding noir thriller, Built from Her Bones weaves a tale of vengeance, redemption, and the cost of chasing monsters in a city that never sleeps.
summary: In the rain-soaked streets of Port Sentinel, Special Agent Damon Parker hunts a killer whose crimes echo the darkest moment of his past: the brutal murder of his mother. Each body left behind is a meticulously staged tableau, marked by a single lilac petal, a chilling signature that drags Damon back to the night his world shattered. As the body count rises, the killer, Anthony Vexler, a man of chilling precision and hidden scars, plays a deadly game, taunting Damon with cryptic messages and personal relics.

With his team, rookie Joe Ortega and sharp profiler Natalie Rivera, Damon chases leads through seedy bars, decaying apartments, and forgotten parks, unraveling a pattern that points to a mastermind orchestrating chaos from the shadows. But every step closer to Vexler pulls Damon deeper into his trauma, threatening to break him before he can stop the next kill. As the stakes escalate and allies fall, Damon must confront the ghosts of his past to end the game or become its final piece.

patchwork.title: Patchwork
patchwork.subtitle: Chronicles of the Mind
patchwork.coverAlt: Patchwork: Chronicles of the Mind book cover
patchwork.shortDescription: Bite-sized stories inspired by random writing prompts and long nights filled with caffeine-fueled boredom. Think of them as mental popcorn: quick, crunchy, and oddly satisfying.
summary: I began writing these stories to keep my mind from turning into mush during those 2 a.m. existential crises. Now, I'm sharing them so you can take a glimpse into the chaos. They're perfect for those moments when you're stuck in the bathroom, forgot your phone, and suddenly realize you have nothing but your thoughts and questionable tile grout to stare at.

misadventures_of_zeke_and_liz.title:
Misadventures of
Zeke and Liz
misadventures_of_zeke_and_liz.subtitle: The ARG Bureau
misadventures_of_zeke_and_liz.coverAlt: Misadventures of Zeke and Liz book cover
misadventures_of_zeke_and_liz.shortDescription: Darkly satirical, psychologically gripping, and eerily plausible, a story about how institutions crumble when they mistake fiction for fact, and how obsession can turn surveillance into self-destruction.
misadventures_of_zeke_and_liz.summaryLead: When conspiracies become code, reality is the game.
summary: TFBI agents Tom Kendrick and Carla Mendez are assigned to monitor two fringe conspiracy streamers, Zeke and Elizabeth. What starts as routine surveillance quickly turns into obsession as the pair's cryptic broadcasts begin aligning with real-world anomalies: financial transfers, coded threats, and echoes of past collapses.

Drawn further onto the web, Tom drinks to silence the voices invading his dreams, while Carla creates a shrine of notes and red string in her apartment. Treasury analysts, CIA operatives, and even the Bureau itself become entangled in the spiral, chasing phantom funds and recursive signals that seem meant to trap them. But the deeper they go, the line between fact and fiction blurs.

Zeke and Elizabeth's language shifts into the grammar of games, final bosses, PvP arenas, and loot drops until the agents realize the unthinkable: they are not tracking terrorists but players in an elaborate alternate reality.

the_advocates_hunger.title: The Advocate's Hunger
the_advocates_hunger.shortDescription: Set against the backdrop of gritty courtrooms, tense prison visits, and the justice system's moral ambiguity, Ellie must confront the darkest parts of herself. How far is she willing to go to win? And when the line between advocate and something far more dangerous blurs, will she be able to pull herself back?
summary: Ellie Keene is a rising star in the high-stakes world of court appeals. Driven and uncompromising, she will do whatever it takes to save her clients. When she takes on the case of Grant Vale, a convicted murderer with a chilling presence and a complex past, Ellie believes it's just another battle in the courtroom.

But as Ellie immerses herself in Vale's case, the boundaries between professional duty and personal hunger begin to dissolve. Late-night case preparations turn electric. Courtroom strategy sessions become tense. What starts as a fight for justice slowly transforms into a consuming obsession that threatens everything Ellie has built: her career, her ethics, and her sanity.

Set against the backdrop of gritty courtrooms, tense prison visits, and the justice system's moral ambiguity, Ellie must confront the darkest parts of herself. How far is she willing to go to win? And when the line between advocate and something far more dangerous blurs, will she be able to pull herself back?
The Advocate's Hunger is the third installment in Zachery Clark's Mayhem at Midnight series.

the_denver_protocol.title:
Misadventures of 
Zeke and Liz
the_denver_protocol.subtitle: The Denver Protocol
the_denver_protocol.shortDescription: Book Two of The Misadventures of Zeke and Liz: The Denver Protocol is a sharp, absurd, and surprisingly heartfelt conspiracy comedy about belief, bureaucracy, and the dangerous idea that someone has to stand in the middle of the circle.
summary: When conspiracy podcast hosts Zeke and Liz land in Denver to investigate the airport’s infamous secrets, they expect the usual mix of tinfoil theories, bad coffee, and a blue horse statue with glowing red eyes. What they don’t expect is a tiny cowboy hat in a Ziplock bag, a cult that treats headwear as sacred geometry, and an underground machine for the size of a city block that may or may not be holding the planet’s rotation together by an eighth of an inch.

Dragged into a turf war between the Astral Cartographers Guild and the Navigators who built the Astro Engine, Zeke finds himself declared the long-prophesied Brim-Bearer, mostly because his podcast has good download numbers. Liz, armed with spreadsheets, dry sarcasm, and a lint roller, tries to keep them both alive while the tunnels fill with black-hat pilots, government liaisons, and one very anxious man who has been living in the ventilation shafts with a stopwatch and Funyuns.

As the Engine’s pulse climbs and the formation of brown hats begins to chant, Zeke and Liz discover that the real conspiracy isn’t just under the airport—it’s wearing a hat, quoting celestial coordinates, and insisting that the fate of the world depends on a podcast host who can’t stop narrating.
